description: vacation.rs: serde_json::to_value(&err).map_err(|e| JmapError::server_fail(e.to_string()))? on SetError is inconsistent with the rest of the codebase which uses .expect('SetError derives Serialize and is always serializable'). The map_err/? pattern is misleading — it suggests the serialization can fail and the whole handler returns early with a server error, but SetError is always serializable. The .expect() pattern documents the invariant correctly. Fix: replace all vacation.rs serde_json::to_value map_err patterns with .expect() to match email.rs, mailbox.rs, etc.
title: vacation.rs: use .expect() for infallible serde_json::to_value
